newsitem.title: CHINA: China's bike makers studying market needs.
newsitem.headline: China's bike makers studying market needs.

text.p: China's bicycle manufacturers are shifting emphasis to production of sleaker models from the heavy, black peddlers they now produce in the face of stagnant growth and a saturated market, state media said on Sunday.
Bicycle and component factories have mushroomed, resulting in market disorder and huge oversupply, the China Daily Business Weekly said on Sunday.
In the northern port city of Tianjin alone, more than 300 small-scale bicycles or components plants sprang up, capable of producing more than 6.0 million bicycles a year.
Foreign investment further aggravated the problem because of its emphasis on large-scale production, the newspaper said.

In January-August, China's large and medium-sized enterprises turned out 18.57 million bicycles, of which only about 14.47 million were sold, it quoted Qiu Boxin, deputy secretary general of the China Bicycle Association, as saying.

Some enterprises are producing small batches of new products to test the market, with multi-speed bicycles becoming popular. Bicycles with suspension have drawn interest and foldable models are also believed to have market potential, the newspaper said.
Foreign investment is encouraged, but as a means of boosting quality rather than quantity, it said.
